item: The Library figures' carried mentions count is about the file it was counted over, not the engine object
summary: /api/database/figures carried a finished whole-table keyword_mentions count for ten times its own duration, keyed on the session's bind alone. A restore swaps the file under the ONE module-level engine (a VACUUM and the panic wipe change the file the same way), so a count taken over the old file was carried as the new corpus's. The memo now rides the shape /api/insights/status has: engine object AND corpus epoch AND a generation served_cache.invalidate() bumps (registered with on_invalidate); a count that was running when the corpus was swapped is not remembered and its payload carries __discard__ so it is not cached as counted (a failure recorded across a swap likewise). The generation is read before the first read of the database. No payload field, schema or chrome string changes. Red-without by five mutations (hook removed, epoch check removed, generation check at store removed, generation read after the first read, failure discard removed). Also corrects the status memo's comment, which still said the panic wipe forgot nothing (it does since #1496).
